name: Real Estate Marketing Framework
description: Comprehensive templates for real estate agents, brokerages, property management, and real estate services

pain_points: Fear of making wrong property investment decisions
Uncertainty about property values and market timing
Previous bad experiences with real estate agents
Stress from mortgage and financing complications
Time pressure from competitive market conditions
Lack of local market knowledge and insights

value_propositions.template: Navigate [local area] real estate with insider market knowledge and [years] years of local expertise
Stress-free [buying/selling] with step-by-step guidance and full-service support from start to closing
Proven results: Average [percentage]% over asking price for sellers, [days] average days on market
Cutting-edge marketing technology and data analysis to maximize your property's exposure and value

home_buying.template: From pre-approval to keys in hand, we guide first-time and experienced buyers through every step of the home buying process with personalized service and market expertise.

home_selling.template: Sell your home faster and for top dollar with our comprehensive marketing strategy, professional staging guidance, and expert negotiation skills.

investment_properties.template: Build wealth through real estate with expert guidance on investment properties, rental income analysis, and portfolio growth strategies.

luxury_homes.template: Discreet, white-glove service for luxury property transactions with exclusive market access, confidential marketing, and concierge-level support.

commercial_real_estate.template: Strategic commercial real estate solutions for business owners and investors, including market analysis, lease negotiations, and investment advisory.
